 The latest edition of ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars is commencing on the 19th of November with Bangladesh A taking on Hong Kong, China in the inaugural match at the University of Doha for Science and Technology in Doha. The Final Match of ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 will be played from the 29th of November.
 2 venues have been finalized for the tournament. They are: 
 University of Doha for Science and Technology, Doha
 West End Park International Cricket Stadium, Doha
 A total of 8 teams are taking part in ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. They are: 
 Afghanistan A
 Bangladesh A
 Hong Kong, China
 Sri Lanka A
 India A
 Nepal
 Pakistan A
 UAE
 The teams are divided into two groups of 4 teams each. 
 Group A
 Afghanistan A
 Bangladesh A
 Hong Kong, China
 Sri Lanka A
 Group B
 India A
 Nepal
 Pakistan A
 UAE
 A total of 12 Group Matches will be played in a single round robin format. Each team will play against the other 3 teams in their group once. After the group stages, the top 2 teams from each group will play in the Semi Final Matches. Winners of the Semi Finals will lock horns in the Final on 29th of November, 2026 .
 The last edition of ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars was won by Pakistan A. They beat Bangladesh A in the Final through a Super Over.
 Previous Edition Stats:
 Winners - Pakistan A
 Runners up - Bangladesh A
 Top Run Scorer - Maaz Sadaqat, 258 Runs (Pakistan A)
 Top Wicket Taker - Ripon Mondol, 11 Scalps (Bangladesh A)
 Highly talented players like Rajat Patidar, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Abdul Samad, Sufyan Moqim, Pavan Rathnayake, Saif Hassan, Sandeep Lamichhane, Babar Hayat and Ikram Alikhil are taking part in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026.
